title: Homelab Infrastructure Shape
description: Declarative shape of a unit of homelab infrastructure to be provisioned by the C#-native engine. See ADR-0001.

apiVersion.description: Schema version. Bumped when the shape contract changes.

kind.description: What this shape describes. 'Node' is a physical Proxmox host (described, not provisioned via API — it hosts the LXCs/VMs).

stack.description: Owning Homelab.Stacks.* submodule. Omit for hub-owned (non-stack) infra.

spec.description: Kind-specific desired state. Validated loosely in Phase 1; tightened per-kind as the engine matures.

node.description: Target Proxmox node (e.g. 'hpe-01'). Required for LXC/VM.

app.description: community-scripts slug selecting which ct/<app>.sh to run (e.g. 'docker', 'debian'). Required for LXC created via the community-scripts deploy path (BL-013).

unprivileged.description: Unprivileged container. LXC. Maps to var_unprivileged.

os.description: Base OS for the container (e.g. 'debian', 'alpine'). Maps to var_os.

storage.description: Proxmox storage for the container/VM disk (e.g. 'local-lvm').

templateStorage.description: Proxmox storage holding the template (e.g. 'local'). LXC.

mounts.description: Storage mounts (e.g. NFS shares from the NAS).
